title: Development and preliminary validation of a CD161 immunoscore-based screening method for latent tuberculosis infection in a Chinese training cohort.
summary: The deep-learning flow-cytometry immunoscore showed a preliminary CD161-based screening signal; source limitations include post-treatment cases as a proxy and a small all-male evaluation cohort. Published in Microbiology Spectrum.
ai_technology: Official ASM Methods/Results checked; phase 1 used post-treatment TB cases as a proxy, phase 2 was all-male with 11 IGRA-positive participants and a post-hoc cutoff.
